title: Tech-Spec Sanity Check Output
description: Mechanical consistency check of phase1-tech-spec.md against frozen phase1-spec.md (and optional phase1-ui-outline.md / phase1-nltp.md). Advisory only — never blocks freeze. Categories are deliberately narrow to prevent drift into subjective architectural judgment.

outcome.description: clean = no findings. findings_present = at least one finding listed.

category.description: spec_consistency = a decision in phase1-tech-spec.md contradicts the frozen phase1-spec.md (or phase1-ui-outline.md when present) without an Amendment Gate row in §7. evidence_gap = a locked decision in §3/§5/§6 is missing its evidence row or rationale. nltp_coverage = a scenario in phase1-nltp.md (when present) is not covered by the tech-spec's verification path.

tech_spec_location.description: Specific anchor in phase1-tech-spec.md (e.g., '§3 row 2', '§5 — Database', '§7'). Bare section number is acceptable when row is not applicable.

finding.description: One-line mechanical observation. No subjective evaluation. No suggestions about whether the underlying decision is good or bad — only whether it is internally consistent and evidenced.

severity.description: info = consistency observation worth noting. warn = likely silent spec violation or substantive evidence gap. There is no 'block' severity — this check never blocks freeze.
